claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held on March 15, 2026.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won the Oscar for Best Cinematography for her work on Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first woman to win the Academy Award for Best Cinematography.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw is the first Black person to win the Academy Award for Best Cinematography.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw won Best Cinematography for Sinners at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Dan Laustsen was nominated for Best Cinematography for Frankenstein at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Darius Khondji was nominated for Best Cinematography for Marty Supreme at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Michael Bauman was nominated for Best Cinematography for One Battle After Another at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Adolpho Veloso was nominated for Best Cinematography for Train Dreams at the 2026 Academy Awards.
Sinners won the Best Actor award at the 2026 Oscars.
Sinners won the Best Original Score award at the 2026 Oscars.
